title: Guided Forge Interviews, Templates, Clone/Fork & Advisory Authoring

acceptance: fork creates a distinct identity with provenance
optional advisory AI cannot publish or canonize
guided and advanced authoring converge on the same governed schema
boundaries: MRCS-03 extends the MRCS-01 workspace/schema kernel; it does not create a parallel authoring database or schema path.
ARI/PCA retain generic identity, provenance, derivative lineage, rights/use and version/review authority.
Owner-domain contracts retain semantic authority for authored definitions.
Advisory AI is optional and cannot publish, canonize or mutate runtime/live owner state.

MRCS-04+ remain unauthorized until separately selected.
MSAS and MVPS lane selectors/branches/authority are independent and must not be rewritten by MRCS work.
